rule.description: Consistent naming and zero technical debt. No exceptions. Always search existing codebase before creating anything new.
rule.prohibited-files: CHANGES_*.md, SUMMARY_*.md, WORKFLOW_SETUP_GUIDE.md, one-off documentation files, temporary explanation files

before-create.step: Search existing codebase for similar functions/patterns
Check for duplicates — never create what already exists
Match language conventions (camelCase for JS, snake_case for Python)

code-quality.never: partial implementations, TODOs in simplified code, duplicate functions, mixed concerns (UI+DB), resource leaks, dead code, inconsistent formatting
code-quality.always: SRP, separation of concerns, resource cleanup, consistent error handling, meaningful names, DRY

anti-patterns.over-engineering: No unnecessary abstractions, no factory patterns for simple functions, no middleware for trivial ops
anti-patterns.under-engineering: No skipped error handling, no ignored edge cases, no hardcoded configurable values

violations.violation: Using prohibited suffixes in any name
Creating one-off documentation files without explicit request
Duplicating existing functions without searching first
